name: flexlug
description: Skills and plugins by Flexlug for Claude Code and other Agent Skills compatible harnesses.

plugins.name: ssh-session
plugins.description: Run commands on a remote host over a persistent SSH session instead of a bare `ssh host "cmd"` — one live connection per named session, so cwd, env vars, venvs and background jobs survive between tool calls, and interactive prompts can be answered. Stdlib-only Python driver, no tmux and no pip packages.
